name: Ian Tivendale
description: Ian Tivendale stands as the indomitable force behind HACSA, a towering warrior whose mere presence inspires allies and terrifies foes. His armor is adorned with intricate runes of leadership, shimmering in the sunlight. Known for his unyielding resolve, Ian wields a massive warhammer named 'Verdict,' said to shatter shields with a single blow. His calm yet commanding demeanor has earned him the title 'The Lion of the Highlands,' a true protector of the realm.

name: Chris Keen (Angar Skeggisson)
description: Known far and wide as Angar Skeggisson, Chris Keen is the ultimate tactician and master of subterfuge. Donning armor etched with symbols of cunning and foresight, he carries a pair of finely crafted axes, each engraved with Nordic glyphs. Angar's sharp intellect and ability to read the battlefield have made him a legend among warriors. His strategies are as ruthless as they are effective, earning him the epithet 'The Shadow of Victory.'

name: Kedrixx Streit
description: Kedrixx Streit is the fearless and strategic leader of the Red Deer Reavers, a knight known for his fiery resolve and unmatched skill in combat. Clad in battle-scarred armor, his presence on the battlefield is as fierce as a storm. Kedrixx wields the 'Blazing Blade,' a sword forged in dragon fire, which glows with an inner light during combat. His aggressive tactics and charismatic leadership have solidified his reputation as 'The Vanguard of Flames.'

name: Berny Franco
description: Berny Franco, the mighty blacksmith of the Reavers, is a stout and powerful warrior whose strength is legendary. His armor, forged by his own hands, gleams with enchantments of durability. Berny wields a colossal forge hammer, 'Iron Song,' capable of breaking through even the sturdiest defenses. Known for his unyielding tenacity, he is affectionately called 'The Anvil of the Reavers.'

name: Garrett Robson
description: Garrett Robson, the versatile all-rounder, is known as 'The Titan's Bastion' among his peers. His armor is an intricate blend of steel and leather, allowing for both flexibility and protection. Garrett wields a shield and longsword, both engraved with the sigil of a roaring bear, symbolizing his strength and loyalty. His dual role as a family man and a fearsome warrior adds a layer of compassion and drive to his persona, making him the heart of the Reavers.

name: Keston Piche
description: Keston Piche is the unofficial assistant team lead, always dependable and quick-witted. His balanced approach to combat is reflected in his symmetrical armor, polished to a mirror shine. Keston wields a spear and round shield, both decorated with intricate carvings representing harmony. His sharp instincts and even-tempered nature have earned him the nickname 'The Sentinel of Serenity.'

name: Monty Jones
description: Monty Jones is the Reavers' enigmatic wildcard, a knight whose unpredictability keeps both allies and enemies on edge. His jagged, asymmetrical armor bears marks of chaos, hinting at his untamed fighting style. Monty wields dual curved blades, which flash like lightning in the midst of battle. His erratic movements and daring strategies have earned him the moniker 'The Tempest of Shadows.'

name: Nate Randall
description: Born to fight, Nate Randall embodies the raw essence of combat. His armor is simple yet robust, a testament to his focus on skill over ornamentation. Nate wields a greatsword named 'Truth,' forged to cut through deception and weakness alike. His intense gaze and relentless pursuit of victory have earned him the title 'The Blade of Resolve.'
